title: Portfolio Selection Based on Modified CoVaR in the Gaussian Framework
content: We study the Mean-Risk model, where risk is measured by the Modified CoVaR \[ \CoVaR^{\leq}_{\alpha, \beta}(X|Y) = VaR_\beta ( X \;| \; Y + VaR_\alpha (Y) \leq 0).\] We prove that in Gaussian setting, for sufficiently small $\beta$, such model has a solution.
